content:
Screenshots shown in the ORA eTraining lesson "Budget Transfer Requests — Navigating Banner: Essentials for Research Administration".
Module: Navigating Banner: Essentials for Research Administration.
Open the lesson: https://share.articulate.com/P5hdpOIVrXhCKX63DYkkA#/lessons/MLA45EqLTDlds1qVeupBy6oBgh6G6TwS

These are VERBATIM machine transcriptions of the text visible in each screenshot -- Banner screens, forms and system dialogs. They are read off images, not authored prose: check the lesson itself before relying on a specific figure or field value.

--- Screenshot: My Journals ---
My Finance

Hello Ryan,
Create, edit and approve transactions and view financial information for department / organization.

My Finance Query
Create, view and share budget availability, encumbrance and
payroll queries.

My Journals
Create and view draft, pending and completed journals and
supporting documentation.

Approve Documents
View list of documents pending approval. Approve, disapprove, or
deny.

My Requisitions
Create and view draft, pending and completed requisitions and
supporting documentation.

Delete Finance Template
Delete templates for Finance Queries, Budget Development, and
Purchase Orders.

View Document
View draft, pending and completed documents with related
information and approval history.
